task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Use the left arm to move the cuboid tea box to the left of the oval-shaped mouse for computer use.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，用左臂将长方体茶盒移至椭圆形鼠标左侧供电脑使用。
